subject.title: feat(gateway): typed structured questions on openclaw.chat with live option cards

question: Should `SystemAgentChatQuestion` become the supported cross-client gateway presentation contract for system-agent onboarding and wizard choices?
rationale: The implementation deliberately extends a public protocol rather than repairing an established broken contract; code review cannot decide the intended long-term API and client-ownership policy.

options.title: Approve the additive contract
options.body: Keep the optional typed field, require inspectable web-chat proof, and treat the gateway schema plus generated client bindings as the supported compatibility surface.

options.title: Keep structured presentation web-local
options.body: Avoid expanding the gateway protocol and place any temporary custodian-only rendering data behind a non-public web boundary instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the additive contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional typed field, require inspectable web-chat proof, and treat the gateway schema plus generated client bindings as the supported compatibility surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR history identifies this author as the designer of the onboarding redesign and typed gateway proposal.
